name.baseName: Disposal, PVC sealing sheet, 1.64% water, to municipal incineration

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: This dataset represents the activity of waste disposal of waste sealing sheet, polyvinylchloride in a municipal solid waste incinerator (MSWI) Recommended use of this dataset: For disposal of bulk or small parts of PVC sealing sheet (waste building product) Inventoried waste contains 1.7% Glass; 53.9% PVC sealing sheet; 11% Filler (lime); 33.4% plastiziser; . Waste composition (wet, in ppm): upper heating value 23.26 MJ/kg; lower heating value 22.53 MJ/kg; H2O 1387.9; O 124680; H 61320; C 490710; S 1000; N 553.8; P n.a.; B n.a.; Cl 249040; Br 38.689; F 8.1246; I n.a.; Ag n.a.; As 1.2205; Ba 103.08; Cd 1.4498; Co 17.46; Cr 28.23; Cu 14.921; Hg 0.47261; Mn 44.17; Mo n.a.; Ni 11.754; Pb 14601; Sb 23.748; Se 1.1607; Sn 205.09; V 159.26; Zn 33.914; Be 0.27635; Sc n.a.; Sr 48.914; Ti 552.7; Tl 0.22108; W n.a.; Si 6104.5; Fe 2059.2; Ca 45238; Al 110.54; K n.a.; Mg n.a.; Na 1906; Share of carbon in waste that is biogenic 0%. Share of metals in waste not oxidised and bulk-recyclable (exclude very small or thin parts) Iron: 0%; Alu: 0%; Copper: 0%. One kg of this waste produces 0.1693 kg of slag and 0.1292 kg of residues, which are landfilled. Additional solidification with 0.05169 kg of cement. Net energy production: 2.6MJ/kg electric energy and 5.64MJ/kg thermal energy. Recovery of metal scrap to recycling: 0g iron scrap, 0g aluminium scrap, 0g copper scrap.;; UUID: c00a820d-8f0a-4b2b-b367-4e271adaadf9

time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: Waste composition as given in literature reference, theoretical data or other source. Transfer coefficients for modern MSWI.

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Specific to the technology mix encountered in Switzerland in 2010. Well applicable to modern incineration practices in Europe, North America or Japan.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
average Swiss MSWI plants in 2010 (grate incinerators) with electrostatic precipitator for fly ash (ESP), wet flue gas scrubber and 25% SNCR , 42.77% SCR-high dust , 32.68% SCR-low dust -DeNOx facilities and 0% without Denox (weighted according to mass of burnt waste, representing Swiss average). Efficiency of iron scrap separation from slag : 58%. Efficiency of non-ferrous scrap separation from slag : 31%. Gross electric efficiency technology mix 15.84% and Gross thermal efficiency technology mix 28.51%

# Included processes
Waste incineration from waste reception gate further downstream (excluding transport to the MSWI plant). Waste-specific air and water emisions from incineration, auxiliary material consumption for flue gas cleaning. Short-term emissions to river water and long-term emisisons to ground water from slag compartment (from bottom ash) and residual material landfill (from solidified fly ashes and scrubber slugde). Waste-specific process energy demands for MSWI and net energy generation.
